EN:
Is this a trick or something?
You sent me a letter with
nothing written inside! Is it
invisible ink? You'd have to
tell me how to make it show
up! I just don't get it! Hmph!

Me has enviado una carta en
blanco. ¿Es un truco o algo?
¿Has escrito con tinta
invisible? No entiendo nada,
así que será mejor que me
lo cuentes en persona.

Merci pour ta lettre ! C 2

secrets, je suis pour !!!

faire apparaître l'encre !

Ma cos'era? Uno scherzo?
Mi hai mandato una lettera,
ma non c'era scritto niente!
O era inchiostro simpatico?!
BOH! Non ho capito niente!!!

Soll das hier ein Trick sein?
Du hast mir einen Brief ohne
Inhalt geschickt! Soll das un-

ich die denn jetzt lesen?
Versteh ich nicht! Pfff...

So I got a letter from you,
but there wasn't a single
thing written in it. Was that
an accident? Get more sleep!
You'll make fewer mistakes,
and you'll look better too!

tua lettera... Ma non
c'era scritto niente!

Farai meno pasticci e, si sa,

Ich hab 'nen Brief von dir

und du siehst besser aus!
